title: A gate question that only names a remote ref is classed push and made blocking though nothing is pushed
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons gives a gate the class push only for a question about pushing, publishing or changing a remote, not for one that mentions a remote ref it reads; a worker's gate on a read-only choice stays provisional. Seen in BG-45zpw2go gate g2: 'matched remote' made a fall-back choice blocking.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;c=a.derived_class({}, {'question':'A clone with no integration-remote main ref: does the hook fall back to the local main or settle nothing?','options':['fall back','settle nothing']});print(c);sys.exit(1 if c=='push' else 0)

notes: Seen again in SP-ilje65fa (2026-10-10): five worker gates were made blocking class push only because their questions named a release, a releases list or github.com (ST-wfvkk6jn g2 and g5, ST-ai2xlm7x g1 and g3, ST-v3pruppq g2); none pushed anything, and the ST-v3pruppq worker stopped mid-work on one. Filed as ST draft beside this bug. Filed beside it at the SP-ilje65fa close: ST-gvf6yca7, which keeps the class rule and lets the worker go on.
